food.name: Yinji Rice Rolls (银记肠粉)
food.desc: Last rice-roll breakfast in the old city

food.name: Ng Zham Kee (伍湛记)
food.desc: Longjin East Road; jidi congee with salted fried cakes. Opens 08:00.

items.title: Atour → Chimelong Panda Hotel (长隆熊猫酒店)
items.note: Taxi, ~50 min–1 hr. Navigate to “长隆熊猫酒店”. With many people or bags, book a 6-seater.

items.title: Store luggage; ask at reception
items.note: Four things to confirm: check-in time, shuttle times to each park, how Circus tickets are collected and entry works, and the drone show time and location.

items.title: Lunch: eat early
items.note: Start at 11:45 to beat the 12:00 lunch rush.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
food.desc: No need to leave the hotel

food.name: White Tiger Buffet (白虎自助餐厅)
food.desc: Inside the Chimelong Hotel; white tigers can be watched while eating

food.name: Wanbo business district (万博商圈)
food.desc: Taxi, ~15 min. Many chain teahouses and Cantonese options

items.title: Get to know the resort
items.note: Routes are learned today so the next two mornings run smoothly.

route.title: Panda Hotel (熊猫酒店)
route.desc: Lobby and corridors are decorated with pandas throughout; a first round of photos is taken here.

route.title: Safari Park entrance (野生动物世界入口)
route.walk: Hotel shuttle, or walk as directed by reception
route.desc: Tomorrow's entry gate and queue position are located.

route.title: Circus theatre and Chimelong Paradise North Gate (大马戏剧场、欢乐世界北门)
route.desc: The Circus is next to Chimelong Paradise North Gate. Tonight's entrance is checked, along with the gate for Chimelong Paradise the day after tomorrow.

route.title: Back to the Panda Hotel (回熊猫酒店)

items.tip: Food delivery cannot enter the parks; it is collected from the delivery lockers next to the hotel.

food.name: Panda Hotel lobby bar (熊猫酒店大堂吧)
Panda-themed desserts (熊猫主题甜点)
food.desc: Panda-shaped cakes from the hotel restaurant; good for photos

items.title: Check in, rest
items.note: Check-in opens at 15:00. A nap is advised; the Circus runs until nearly 21:00.

items.title: Dinner: eat early
items.note: Circus doors open at 17:00; standard seats are first come, first served. Christmas Eve is busy, so go straight after eating.

food.name: Panda Hotel restaurant (熊猫酒店餐厅)
Restaurants around the Circus (马戏场周边餐厅)
food.desc: Fast food near the show area, for when time is short

items.title: Hotel → Circus
items.note: Shuttle, ~10 min. Bring the original ID used for booking; it is checked at entry.

items.title: Enter, claim seats
items.note: In at 17:00 when doors open, for central seats on Christmas Eve. Standard seats are unassigned; earlier is better. The wait is long, so snacks, a tablet or small games should be brought for the kids.
items.tip: Own snacks and drinks are allowed, but strong-smelling food such as durian is not.

items.title: Chimelong International Circus (长隆国际大马戏)
items.note: ~80 min, with animals and aerial acrobatics. Light and sound effects are intense; nervous children can sit near the aisle. Entry is officially not recommended for children under 3 or under 1 m tall.

items.title: Back to the hotel
items.note: Exit crowds are heavy. Wait ~10 min for them to thin, then take the shuttle back.

intro:
Check out of Atour; taxi to the Chimelong Panda Hotel
Afternoon: get to know the resort
Evening: Chimelong International Circus (19:30)
